situation: Two weeks ago, you bought a laptop from an online electronics store. When it arrived, the screen was cracked and the computer would not turn on.
task: Write an email to the store's customer service manager in about 150-200 words. You are complaining about the damaged product.
points: Describe what you ordered and when you ordered it.
Explain what is wrong with the product.
State what you would like the store to do.
sample:
Dear Customer Service Manager,

I am writing to complain about a laptop that I recently bought from your online store. I am a regular customer, and this is the first time I have been disappointed with an order.

On March 3, I ordered a 15-inch SilverBook laptop for $1,150. My order number is 48213. The package was delivered to my home five days later.

Unfortunately, when I opened the box, I saw a long crack across the left side of the screen. I also tried to turn the computer on several times, but nothing happened, even after charging it overnight. The box itself looked fine, so I believe the laptop was damaged before it was shipped.

I need a computer for my online classes, so I would like you to send me a replacement as soon as possible. I would also ask you to cover the cost of returning the broken one. If a replacement is not available this week, please give me a full refund instead.

I look forward to your reply.

Sincerely,

Maria Lopez
